final: WITH team_rates AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * w / g) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_win_rate FROM team_rates WHERE avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT team_rates.team_id, team_rates.avg_win_rate, team_rates.record_count, team_rates.avg_win_rate - mean_rate.mean_win_rate AS difference_from_mean FROM team_rates CROSS JOIN mean_rate WHERE mean_rate.mean_win_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
